candidates.name: Sickle Cell Disease

candidates.name: Diabetic Retinopathy
contradict_spans: No dehydration or other precipitating factors were noted

candidates.name: Retinal Vein Occlusion
support_spans: abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula, with increased intercapillary spacing and small areas of hypofluorescence nasal to the fovea
contradict_spans: Normal cilioretinal, retinal arteriolar, and retinal venous filling
candidates.why: The patient's fluorescein angiography findings could be consistent with retinal vein occlusion, but the normal retinal venous filling makes it less likely.
